summaryZh: Dore 实验室研究阿尔茨海默病背景下突触弱化的分子机制，并寻找保护突触连接的途径。团队使用疾病模型小鼠、原代神经元与器官型切片、荧光寿命成像、免疫组织化学、生物化学及膜片钳电生理。
researchQuestions: 阿尔茨海默病中突触减弱的分子机制是什么？
methods: 原代神经元与器官型切片

evidence.quote: We are interested in understanding molecular mechanisms underlying synaptic weakening in the context of AD and finding ways to protect those precious connections against neurodegeneration.

Techniques & Approaches AD model mice Primary neurons and organotypic slices Fluorescence lifetime imaging Immunohistochemistry Biochemical approaches (palmitoylation assay, CoIP) Patch-clamp electrophysiology
